text.content:
The biggest mall in America, never finished.

Region: Coastview, Pacifica
Controlled by: Contested: Voodoo Boys below, a Barghest sniper above
The feel of it: No roof, no doors, three floors of concrete
Danger: SC 2

A Night Market every weekend, a Voodoo Boy server farm in the basement, and a Barghest sniper's nest on the roof. Its Pacifica Line station is a squat.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04, 12
